item.title: Bilaspur Tragedy: Woman Stabs Boyfriend to Death After Being Blocked Online in Chhattisgarh, Accused Arrested
item.description: A 22-year-old woman was arrested in Chhattisgarh's Bilaspur on Wednesday, February 4, for allegedly stabbing her boyfriend to death following a heated argument over their deteriorating relationship. The incident occurred in the city's Civil Lines area after the victim reportedly blocked the woman’s phone number and social media accounts.

item.title: Motorola Razr 50 Receives Major Android 16 Update; 2024 Foldable Phone Gets New Features and Enhanced Connectivity Rolling Out to More Users
item.description: Motorola has begun rolling out the Android 16 update for the Razr 2024, starting in Canada. The 2GB upgrade introduces a unified 'Modes' setting, password-free hotspot connectivity, and improved hearing aid support. This is the second major OS update for the foldable, with enhanced security features also included.
